headline: Frontlines Shift as Bases Trade Hands Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the tempo of base turnover has quickened on the bloodiest fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the war’s graveyard, its toll climbing to 164,958 Colonial and 181,608 Warden dead with fourteen ownership changes in the past day; both casualty streams and enlistments are now accelerating. Linn Mercy continues to drive the heaviest fighting around Lathair and Rotdust, logging twenty flips, 52,569 Colonial and 65,571 Warden casualties, while recruitment surges. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to seventeen flips, Colonial losses at 46,634 and Warden at 58,014, with casualties and sign‑ups both accelerating. Stlican Shelf reports six flips, casualties climbing to 52,944 Colonial and 58,827 Warden, and accelerating loss and enlistment trends. Deadlands adds five flips, its 24‑hour toll reaching 97,332 Colonial and 134,796 Warden dead, with both sides’ loss rates accelerating. Mooring County holds at five flips but shows a steep 24‑hour rise of 551 Colonial and 509 Warden dead, enlistments also accelerating. Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors report no ownership changes.
